## What type of contribution is this?

- [ ] Content correction (indicator, score, status, source)
- [ ] New risk proposal
- [ ] Bug report (UI, build, data integrity)
- [ ] Documentation / diagrams
- [ ] Code (component, performance, accessibility)

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what and why. -->

## Details

<!-- For corrections: the entry, the current value, the proposed value, and the evidence.
     For proposals: the failure mode, warning signs, precautions, mitigations, timeline.
     For bugs: steps to reproduce, expected vs actual. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run validate` passes
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `bun run lint` passes
- [ ] Every claim links to a primary source
- [ ] No invented precision (ranges or ≈ where uncertain)
